messages:
Rina Shah: quick UX callout on the compact ledger: where should export & token details live when toggling org vs project? mock here: https://redwood.app/ux/1865433000.png
Tom Becker: two patterns we keep debating: 1) tiny inline kebab per row that reveals Download / Tokens, 2) persistent header toolbar for bulk/filtered exports. both have tradeoffs.
Diego Morales: kebab = low density, discoverability problem for occasional users. toolbar = clearer for bulk but less obvious for single invoices. accountants usually expect a row-level affordance.
Linnea Berg: accessibility note: if we use kebab, the menu must be reachable via keyboard and announce the action like "Download invoice for <scope>". also ensure focus returns to the row after action.
Rina Shah: thinking about a compact hybrid: show a small export icon inline only on hover/focus, and a sticky bulk CTA in the toolbar when rows are selected. minimizes noise.
Tom Becker: implementation concern: hover-only icons don't help keyboard users. make sure the icon is always focusable (tab stop) even if visually hidden until focus.
Diego Morales: performance: virtualized list + per-row buttons is heavy. option: render the inline button only for visible rows and use event delegation (one handler) to reduce nodes.
Linnea Berg: token breakdown UX: inline expand under row vs anchored right flyout. inline expand is better for screen readers; flyout keeps the list compact and scannable.
Rina Shah: can we lazy-load token breakdown details on expand so inline doesn't inflate initial payload?
DevBot: FYI: perf test for lazy-load pattern shows initial paint 120ms -> 130ms, and expand latency <50ms on slow network. link: https://redwood.app/perf/1865433000
Tom Becker: microcopy suggestions: inline export -> label "Download invoice (PDF)"; toolbar bulk -> "Export invoices (filtered)"; kebab menu item -> "View token breakdown". include aria-hidden icons with sr-only full context.
Diego Morales: question: org vs project scope CTA text. Should we show scope inline? e.g., "Download invoice (Acme — Payments) (PDF)" might be long but clearer.
Linnea Berg: prefer concise visible text + visually-hidden context: visible "Download (PDF)", sr-only "Download invoice for Acme Corp — project: Payments — May 2026 (PDF)". keeps layout tidy.
Rina Shah: acceptance criteria for prototype: 1) keyboard users can download a single invoice without using mouse; 2) SR reads scope for each download; 3) virtualization perf within 10% of baseline; 4) discoverability test with 6 non-power users.
Tom Becker: I'll spike delegated handler + focus management for keyboard-only flows.
Diego Morales: I'll sketch both inline-expand and flyout token views in Figma and mark where lazy-load hooks go.
Rina Shah: cool. I'll update the mock and set up a 2-week A/B test: variant A = inline-hover+toolbar, variant B = kebab-only with bulk toolbar. metrics: downloads per invoice, keyboard download pct, support tickets about exports.
DevBot: Experiment queued: ab_test_id=exp_512, variants=[A_inline_toolbar,B_kebab_toolbar], duration=14d, tracking=[download_click, keyboard_download, sr_actions].
Linnea Berg: tagging @Tom for ARIA copy once the frames are in. thanks team! :sparkles:
